# How to publish Hand Fighter on itch.io — click by click

You are logged in at itch.io → Dashboard. Click **"Create new project"** and fill in:

## Basic info
| Field | What to enter |
|---|---|
| **Title** | `Hand Fighter` |
| **Project URL** | `hand-fighter` (it becomes syedzada689.itch.io/hand-fighter) |
| **Short description / tagline** | `Fight with your hands — a webcam gesture-controlled fighting game. Punch, kick and block in the air. Vs CPU, 2P on one camera, or online with a friend.` |
| **Classification** | Games |
| **Kind of project** | **HTML** ← important! |
| **Release status** | Released |
| **Pricing** | **"$0 or donate"** (lets people support you, keeps the game free) |

## Uploads
1. Click **Upload files** → choose **`hand-fighter-web.zip`** (in this dist folder)
2. Tick **"This file will be played in the browser"** ← important!

## Embed options (appears after the upload)
- **Viewport dimensions:** `1280` × `720`
- ✅ **Mobile friendly** (check it — the game has touch controls)
- **Orientation:** Landscape
- ✅ **Fullscreen button**
- If you see **Frame options / permissions** with a **camera** checkbox — check it (lets hand tracking work inside the itch player). If there's no such option, don't worry: the game automatically falls back to keyboard/touch.

## Details
- **Genre:** Action
- **Tags:** `fighting`, `webcam`, `arcade`, `2d`, `multiplayer`, `local-multiplayer`, `gesture`, `motion-controls`
- **Description:** paste the text below
- **Cover image:** upload **`shots/cover.png`**
- **Screenshots:** upload **`shots/shot-city.png`**, **`shots/shot-dojo.png`**, **`shots/shot-beach.png`**

## Description text (copy-paste)

```
🥊 HAND FIGHTER — the fighting game you control with your bare hands.

No controller. No keyboard needed. Just show your hand to the webcam:

✋ Open palm — lean left/right to move, raise high to jump
✊ Fist — punch
✌️ Two fingers — kick
🤟 Three fingers — block

Chain hits into combos, break your rival's guard, and knock them out across three stages — a neon night city, a lantern-lit dojo, and a sunset beach. Six fighters with different speed, power and health.

🎮 THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• 1 Player — fight the CPU (Easy / Normal / Hard)
• 2 Players — share one camera, one hand each!
• Online — create a room, send the 4-letter code to a friend anywhere in the world

⌨️ No camera? No problem — full keyboard support (P1: A/D/W/S + F/G) and on-screen touch controls on phones.

🔒 Privacy: your camera is processed 100% on your device. No video is ever uploaded, stored or shared.

Best experienced in Chrome or Edge with a webcam and a bit of room to swing your arms. 🥋
```

## Finally
- Scroll to the bottom → **Save & view page** → check it plays → set visibility to **Public**.
- Your game page will be: **https://syedzada689.itch.io/hand-fighter**

## After publishing
1. Play it once ON the itch page to confirm everything works in their player.
2. Share the itch link (it looks more professional than the GitHub one).
3. Next platform: create an account at **developer.crazygames.com** and submit the same game — that's the ad-revenue-share path.
